# Handoff and Documentation

## Goal
Produce documentation that helps developers understand what to build, why it is structured this way, and what remains uncertain.

## Required handoff content
When documenting a screen or design decision, include when possible:
- Screen purpose
- Main user action
- Components used
- Variants and states
- Layout structure
- Spacing logic
- Token usage or assumptions
- Theme or mode behavior
- Responsive notes
- Accessibility notes
- Open questions and validation gaps

## Documentation rules
- Distinguish verified information from assumptions.
- Use explicit and reusable naming.
- Keep documentation structured and implementation-oriented.
- Make uncertainty visible instead of hiding it.
- Prefer clarity over vague exhaustive text.

## Recommended formats
Use:
- Bullet lists for implementation notes
- Tables for decision mapping
- Checklists for validation
